script_text: Air sign Aquarius, Uranus fires your 1st House this week while Saturn squares your career axis — expect everything to shift by Friday. Monday brings the Sun conjunct Jupiter in your 7th House, spotlighting a key relationship. Tuesday's Mercury-Uranus square creates dangerous miscommunications around money — pause before signing. Wednesday shifts dramatically when Venus enters Leo and conjuncts your 7th House cusp, activating a love transit demanding total honesty. Thursday onward, Mars enters your 10th House of Career, fueling ambition. The weekend Full Moon lights your 1st House with raw self-revelation, while Sunday's Uranus-Jupiter trine opens unexpected doors. Thursday is your power day because Venus enters your 7th House, transforming your partnerships. Tuesday is your worst day because Mercury squares Uranus, causing financial confusion and communication breakdowns. Review every contract clause twice this week — Mercury's square with Uranus hides traps in fine print. Follow for daily updates.
